name: MAGIC MIRROR HALL
source:
MAGIC MIRROR HALL is a free visual novel about an established relationship from an outsider's perspective.

Running a magical apothecary on your own isn’t easy, especially when your friends’ relationship drama suddenly becomes your problem.

Play as Alex as they try to figure out how to fix Malinder’s magical malady, while assuaging Sol’s anxiety about her ailing girlfriend.

[From [url=https://theapothecary.itch.io/magic-mirror-hall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《魔法镜厅》是一部免费视觉小说，从局外人视角讲述一段已经建立的关系。

独自经营魔法药店并不容易，尤其当朋友的感情纠纷突然变成你的问题时。

扮演亚历克斯，想办法治好马林德的魔法疾病，同时安抚索尔对生病女友的焦虑。

[来源：[url=https://theapothecary.itch.io/magic-mirror-hall]Itch.io[/url]]
